live_synthetic_postgis.limitations: Read-only synthetic constants and the real pure area evaluator; no signed Save, real account, candidate retrieval or dispatch was executed.

source_tests.before_change: 25/25 Node checks across saved-area retrieval and TODAY; generator --check PASS; 4/4 Python source tests PASS

remaining_contract.physical_reader: No persisted examined cursor; p_limit counts admitted outputs. Per-transaction notification budget counts deliveries, not rejected candidate reads.
remaining_contract.remote_reader: remote_wave_candidates_v1b reads local keyset chunks of 500 inside a loop in one invocation; it does not provide a persisted total examined budget.
remaining_contract.required_next_scope: An indexed retrieval superset derived from the latest signed workAreas, preserving exact final matcher and D08 start location; if continuation is required it must atomically bind need/revision and not mistake an incomplete empty scan for exhaustion. Prove sparse candidates, no-match, retries, updates and bounds before a controlled DEV package.
remaining_contract.today_blocker: Required retention source readiness remains false on DEV, so the existing candidate would raise R05_CLOSURE_NOT_READY. User authorization exists; this is an unmet technical precondition, not a request for permission.

minimum_patch_scope_review.decision: No additional index or persistent projection introduced in this round; matching blocker remains open.

authoritative_sources.rule: Use the last successfully saved review per account, ordered by created_at DESC, review_id DESC, exactly as worker_saved_areas_v1. A newer unsaved review must not replace it.

Join both review_id=id and account_id. The reviewed workAreas becomes authoritative through the matching saved row; indexing every draft review alone is insufficient. Expiry of an already accepted review must not erase its saved area.
Preserve the actual owned ACTIVE WORKER profile and final account/world/consent gates.
The current GiST index covers the legacy point. That point cannot veto an explicit saved area.
Keep D08 start-location semantics and task/revision binding; do not invent route geography or a remote pin.
Retain existing per-revision delivery deduplication; it is not a cursor for rejected candidates.

indexed_source_requirements: An indexed superset must cover COUNTRY, CITY through the existing worker_area_city_key_v1 normalization, and every explicit RADIUS among up to five areas. The current validator bounds radiusKm to 1..200; COUNTRY must be the sole area.
Resolve latest-saved ownership before treating an indexed review match as authority; older accepted areas and newer unsaved areas must not create a false positive or suppress a current valid area.
The narrow btree(account_id, created_at DESC, review_id DESC) would speed the existing per-account lookup, but would not resolve global far-worker scanning; it was deliberately not added.

Prefer indexes/derived expressions over the existing signed records if real PostgreSQL/PostGIS plans can prove the required superset and bounded work. A new persistent projection is a broader change requiring atomic Save maintenance and lifecycle review; it was not introduced by this review.
minimum_patch_scope_review.continuation_dependency: If indexed retrieval still needs an examined-row limit, dispatch_next_wave and its scheduling/return contract must persist progress atomically for the exact need/revision. An incomplete empty scan must not become NO_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATES or restart at the same prefix. Current notification budgets and remote local chunks do not supply this contract.
closure_conditions: Preserve and explicitly re-evaluate the existing retention_ai_source_ready and closure_source_digest_v5/certified-source conditions. The observed retention readiness is false; do not bypass R05_CLOSURE_NOT_READY or silently rebind a certificate.

Any new persisted projection requires its account ownership, export, erasure and retention coverage before controlled DEV promotion; indexes over current records must still be checked for their effect on the exact closure surface.
A future package must pin the post-R08 worker_need_fit_v1 body fd81bdd1a86946a43399e136d5534e99 and preserve its signed-service gate; the earlier bootstrap body is not the current DEV predecessor.
minimum_patch_scope_review.required_evidence_before_promotion: Real PostGIS EXPLAIN plus sparse/no-match/edge-of-radius/canonical-city/latest-Save fixtures; the same positive and negative pairs through retrieval, fit, Za mene and dispatch; cap/dedup/retry/revision continuity and independent manual submit/select. The controlled package needs exact preimages, forward/rollback and failure-safe acceptance.

limitations: LOCAL_ONLY fixture uses numeric geography and synthetic area/gate readers; tests characterize injected control flow rather than genuine PostGIS performance, WORLD isolation or full dispatch.
The source retrieval candidate exists and passes isolated tests; old history saying no candidate exists is obsolete, but actual DEV still has the unpatched retrieval/time-tier bodies.
Candidate SQL semantics were not changed; only its deployment limitation was documented and two deterministic characterization tests were added.
